submitted.rationale: Across the line, EQE was low and fairly flat for Sb ≥ 0.28 (about 0.033–0.038%). It rose at the Y-rich end: 0.0504% at Sb = 0.10 and 0.0535% at Sb = 0.09. XRD at index 6 (Sb = 0.10) showed a single phase. The patterns at Sb = 0.055 and 0.17 had extra reflections, which points to secondary phases. That puts the best region around Sb ≈ 0.09–0.10, and index 5 was the highest EQE measured.
